None recurs, so the charge stays nil. It was held at nil, but JNJ books $4,600mm of non-cash amortisation of acquired intangibles inside cost of sales in FY2025 (0000200406-26-000016), 4.88% of revenue, so the charge takes the rebuilt figure: -4.74%. Restated without working capital build: over 2023 to 2025 JNJ's cash flow statement shows receivables up $2,811mm, inventories up $3,901mm, payables and accrued liabilities up $6,344mm, a working capital build of $368mm, 0.14% of revenue. Growth ties that cash up once, not on every product for ever, so the charge falls from -4.74% to -4.88%.
